summary: Silver Bow Mining Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. for its initial public offering of 5,200,000 common shares (plus an over-allotment option of up to 780,000 shares). The offering closed on May 1, 2026, with aggregate net proceeds of approximately $54.6 million after underwriting discounts and expenses. The underwriting agreement contains customary representations, warranties, indemnification, and a lock-up agreement. This is an IPO completion, not a special situation—no M&A, tender, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven classification applies. The filing is a routine current report of a material definitive agreement related to a capital raise.
